title: 千鸟格马甲
prompt: Use case: a real photograph from a luxury pet fashion studio shoot, the kind a premium pet-apparel brand prints in a fashion magazine. Image 1 is the identity reference only, not a pose or background template. Keep the same adult Siberian Husky from Image 1, with grey-and-white coat, classic face mask, upright ears and ice-blue eyes. One pet only, no people, no hands. Set, garment and moment: A sharp menswear-inspired fashion editorial on a slate-blue seamless backdrop, two stacked vintage tan leather suitcases beside the dog. The husky sits tall on the floor in a natural dog pose, chest out, gazing straight into the lens with calm, self-assured ice-blue eyes, mouth closed. It wears a real tailored black-and-white houndstooth wool dog vest made for dogs: it covers its back and chest, its front legs pass through the armholes, it fastens with a buckle strap under the chest and has a brown leather trim at the neck, with a matching brown leather collar. Crisp directional key light, clean graphic shadow. The garment is a real piece of pet clothing sewn for this animal's body shape, the kind actually sold for pets and put on a real dog or cat for a shoot: it wraps the animal's own back, chest and neck, the legs come out of it naturally, the fabric sits with believable weight, small folds and slight bunching where the body bends, and fur pokes out at the edges. The pet keeps its real animal anatomy, proportions and posture; it is clearly an animal wearing pet clothes, not a person. Photographic qualities: one dominant key light with natural falloff, true-to-life fur with individual strands, realistic eye moisture with one catchlight, believable contact shadow on the floor or seat. Medium-format camera, 85-100mm lens at about f/4, refined magazine colour grading, mild contrast, fine grain, no plastic retouching. Attitude: noble, poised and a little aloof, a calm self-assured gaze, so any owner would want this shot of their own pet. Indoor studio only. Framing: Three-quarter to full body: the pet sits or stands in its own natural animal posture at about 55-70% of frame height, so the pet-cut garment is clearly worn on an animal's body, with the set piece partly visible beside it. Avoid: anthropomorphic dressing, a human torso or human shoulders, an upright human-like posture, human dress shirts, shirt collars, neckties, suit lapels on a human-shaped chest, clothes that look painted or pasted onto the fur, a head pasted on a costume, cartoonish costumes, crowns, extra accessories, cluttered sets, outdoor scenery, glowing rim light, oversaturated colours, perfect symmetry, extra limbs, duplicate pets, CGI or illustration look, text, logos or watermark. Return one photograph only.
